literal: In goodness, if the absence of affection appears, him, in lineage, will be doubted.
translation: If a lack of affection or kindness appears in a person's good conduct, their noble lineage will be doubted.
modern: ஒருவனுடைய நல்ல குணங்களில் அன்பு இல்லாத தன்மை வெளிப்பட்டால், அவனுடைய உயர்ந்த குடிப்பிறப்பைப் பற்றி உலகம் ஐயப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how essential love and affection are to a person of noble birth. The word 'நார்' literally means fiber or cord, but here it refers to the bond of affection and kindness that connects people. Even if a person possesses other good qualities, if they show a complete lack of love, people will begin to doubt the nobility of their family background. True nobility is not just about outward manners, but is fundamentally rooted in genuine love for others.
